name: package-name-check
title: Package Name Check
description: npm and pip install-command check that flags lookalikes of popular packages (loadsh, crossenv, jeIlyfish), import names that aren't the package (sklearn, cv2, bs4, PIL), built-ins from the registry, unpublishable names, and via lookup, missing or brand-new names.

meta.stops: Helps catch a typosquatted package before install
meta.summary: Reads an npm or pip install command package by package and flags typosquats, wrong import names and packages that don't exist yet.
meta.server: Pin dependencies with a lockfile and scan installs in CI; a client check is advisory.
catches: Lookalikes of popular packages, including capital I for l
Import names used as install names (sklearn, cv2, bs4, PIL)
Node or Python built-ins installed from the registry (fs, crypto, json)
Names npm or PyPI can't publish
Names that don't exist (AI-hallucinated) or appeared days ago, through your lookup
limits: The popular-package list is a curated sample; pass your own
Existence and age checks need your registry lookup
Doesn't scan package code or check maintainers
a11y: Visible label; ecosystem picker is a labelled radiogroup
Textarea is described by the status (role=status)
Focus returns to a nearby control after a fix

rules.note: Informational. Confirmed npm's 214-character and no-uppercase rules and PyPI's normalization of runs of . - _ to a single -. The incident examples were not re-verified.
